newsitem.title: EGYPT: EGYPT POUND FALLS AGAINST SHORT DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: EGYPT POUND FALLS AGAINST SHORT DOLLAR.

text.p: The Egyptian pound slipped against the dollar on Monday in the private sector market due to a shortage in the U.S. currency, bankers said.
"I don't understand why the dollar is up," said one banker. "It is not in demand but, at the same time, it is short."
Five actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3900 and 3.3940 pounds bid and 3.3910 and 3.3950 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average exchange rate was 3.3921 bid and 3.3937 offered, compared to 3.391875 bid and 3.394375 pounds offered in the interbank market on Sunday.
The Central Bank calculated the average rate at midday as 3.388554 pounds buy and 3.395292 pounds sell.
